integrity: Analytic proof and self-contained exact-rational finite tests; the tests corroborate but do not replace the universal argument. Public-priority/originality comparison remains subject to historical access limits.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two maximal complete subgraphs with a nontrivial shared clique; finite unit-edge graph distance. The nine-vertex minimality is restricted to this family, not all chordal graphs. A plausible historical general spectral source was inaccessible in full text.
title: Exact negative type and the nine-vertex obstruction for two-clique chordal sums
